card.name: Speech and reply nouns after a person
card.fires_on: Nouns for something a person said, such as speech, response or comment, right after a possessive or 'the' in general prose. Also the word 'It' referring back to a speech.

modes.label: Speech-act noun
modes.description: A noun like speech, response or comment naming what a named person said.
modes.example: His<< speech>> to the Republican convention sealed his nomination.

modes.label: Pronoun for a speech
modes.description: 'It' starting a sentence that refers back to a speech just mentioned.

modes.label: Greeting verb
modes.description: A verb of greeting in a sentence about people addressing each other.
modes.example: Those who saw it simply as a way friends<< greet>> each other concluded that it was okay.

card.writes: It lowers the odds of words like message, apology and greetings, which would come next after a speech noun.
